scope: To identify protein-protein interactions, pulldown assays were performed with H1.2 and H1.2 KxUb conjugates.
The supernatant was added to 20 µl Strep-Tactin Superflow resin (IBA Lifescience) and incubated overnight at 4 °C in an overhead shaker.

While HEK 293T lysates were used as the source of interactors, the material analyzed by MS was the affinity-purified elution.
